C0028.title: A Study of the Ticket Scalping App Ecosystem in China
C0028.summary: A study examining the ticket scalping app ecosystem in China reveals that scalpers leverage ticket-snatching bots to directly acquire large volumes of ticket inventory. Using China as a case study, the research investigates the unfair preemption practices in ticket purchasing.

references.title: Tickets or Privacy? Understand the Ecosystem of Chinese Ticket Grabbing Apps
